content.scenarioBrief: A junior analyst asks their manager for a two-day extension on a quarterly report due on Friday.

scriptedUserTurns: I'm still working on the quarterly report, and I'm worried about the Friday deadline. Could I have two more days?
The sales figures are late, and I still need to write the summary. I could send the headline numbers on Friday and the full draft on Monday.
Would Monday afternoon work for you? I want to make sure the board pack is not affected.
Thanks. I'll send the headline numbers by Friday noon and the final draft on Monday.
recordedPersonaTurns: Morning. Before we dive in, how is the quarterly report coming along?
Two more days is more than I expected. What is still missing?
Send me the headline numbers on Friday and the full draft on Monday afternoon. That works.
Good. I will keep the board pack in mind. Send the numbers by noon on Friday.
Agreed. Friday noon for the numbers, Monday afternoon for the final draft.
